  echo 'IndexNow skipped: this image predates deployment revision checks.'
  exit 0
fi
deno run --cached-only --frozen --node-modules-dir=none \
  --allow-read=/app/static --allow-env=BHB_SOURCE_REVISION \
  --allow-net=bighornbyte.com,api.indexnow.org \
  /app/scripts/indexnow.ts --all --wait-seconds=600 || \
  echo 'IndexNow submission failed; retry with the IndexNow workflow after checking the deployment.'

#!/bin/sh
OCC="php /var/www/html/occ"
$OCC app:enable files_external || true

mid() {
  php -r '$n=$argv[1];$j=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true);if(is_array($j))foreach($j as $m){if(isset($m["mount_point"])&&strpos($m["mount_point"],$n)!==false){echo $m["mount_id"];break;}}' "$1" 2>/dev/null
}

ensure() {
  NAME="$1"; DIR="$2"
  if ! $OCC files_external:list --all --output=json 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$DIR"; then
    $OCC files_external:create "$NAME" local null::null -c datadir="$DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  ID=$($OCC files_external:list --all --output=json 2>/dev/null | mid "$NAME")
  if [ -n "$ID" ]; then
    $OCC files_external:option "$ID" readonly true >/dev/null 2>&1
    $OCC files_external:option "$ID" enable_sharing true >/dev/null 2>&1
    echo "ensured external mount '$NAME' (id=$ID) -> $DIR"
  else
    echo "WARN: '$NAME' present/created but could not read id to set options"
  fi
}

ensure "Tailey (private)" /family-data/tailey
ensure "Family recovery"  /family-data/family
exit 0

printf -v port '%04X' "$RSDW_PORT"
for table in /proc/net/udp /proc/net/udp6; do

  while read -r _ address _; do

  done < "$table"
done
